track_geometry_role: WGS84 straight segments between hourly mean source positions; not sailed distance, a current axis, flow orientation or physical current edges. Bearings near stationary positions are unstable.
label: Aleutian / Subarctic region: July1993 observed vector section
velocity_frame: earth coordinates: eastward u and northward v
source_product: hourly reduced product at10m intervals; not native5minute/4m ensembles
layer_weighting: Midpoint cell thickness, clipped at100and300m; jointly valid u/v; coverage<160m produces null means. No vertical interpolation.
source_processing_cautions: GPS selective availability and heading corrections described in provider metadata; velocities already processed by the University of Hawaii.
Provider metadata record CTD wire interference editing and missing bins. The hourly product has no per-cell native editing history; nulls and joint support are retained.
100–300m follows the published regional comparison, not an assumed depth-independent current width.
Track includes small northward steps and a two-hour gap. Preserve acquisition order; do not silently form a single monotone width crossing.
Northern and southern branch windows follow Chen and Firing(2006), section3 paragraph7. Windows are association context, not detected edges.
citation: University of Hawaii / NOAA JASADCP, SAC_ID00016, Gunnar Roden, processed E.Kestenare and E.Firing. Chen,S.,and E.Firing(2006), JGR111,C03001, doi:10.1029/2005JC003064.
